newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: First Engineering sets up China mfg unit.
newsitem.headline: First Engineering sets up China mfg unit.

text.p: First Engineering Ltd said on Monday it had set up a manufacturing and trading company, Shi Cheng Precision Moulds & Plastics (Shanghai) Co (Shi Cheng) to manufacture precision moulds and plastic injection moulding and engage in related trading activities.
It will also provide tooling support to First Engineering's plant in Suzhou and service mult-national corporations in the Shanghai area, First Engineering said in a statement.
A factory with a floor space of 19,000 square feet has been acquired for Shi Cheng, which has a registered capital of US$1.3 million. -- Singapore newsroom 65-8703080
